body:
Closes #6

## Summary

- Records the Phase 1 decision not to build or operate the account backend yet, preserving account-free behavior and zero new ambient network traffic.
- Makes the service cost explicit across engineering, stateful infrastructure, relay capacity, security, reliability, identity, privacy, and on-call ownership, with gates for reconsidering the decision.
- Specifies the deferred endpoint inventory, exact host-binding metadata, QR/code/HPKE pairing flows, local and server data, scope rules, sign-out semantics, reconnect behavior, and security boundaries.
- Includes proposed README privacy changes without applying them to the current product, staged to match the behavior that ships.

## Review follow-up

- Moves the directly paired-device rows in both README privacy sections to the account-free pairing release; only account, directory, relay, and `account.json` disclosures wait for sign-in.
- Defines one inbound host listener and one stable `host.key` for paired-device and multiplayer traffic; a multiplayer invite is a credential onto that listener, not a second listener or key.
- Makes `sessions.summaries` share-gated, requires remote RPC to use tab IDs that the host maps to panes after session scoping, and forbids remote PTY resize or a client-owned viewport.
- States that no current scope covers permission decisions and reserves `permission.respond` for a future explicit scope after a method-by-method threat review.
- Documents the macOS Sequoia and iOS Local Network permission flow, the iOS `NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription`, and the Mac incoming-connections firewall prompt.
- Corrects Tailscale detection to `100.64.0.0/10` and `*.ts.net`, and places daily activity logs under `sessions/<session-id>/activity/<date>.jsonl`.

## Verified

- `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`
- `pnpm vitest run` — 9 files and 65 tests passed
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/project/target/check cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/project/target/check cargo test` — 137 passed, 1 ignored
- `git diff --cached --check`
- Live verification: not applicable; this phase changes documentation only and intentionally adds no product or network behavior.

## Video

No video was recorded because this is a docs-only PR.

## Not verified

- GitHub CI is not green: its `vitest` step fails before collecting tests with `webidl.util.markAsUncloneable is not a function`. The same failure is present on the current `main` run ([100](https://github.com/example/project/actions/runs/100)); the exact local Vitest command passes all 65 tests.
- No account service, sign-in, host binding, pairing transport, relay, settings UI, or cloud machine behavior was built or exercised in Phase 1.
- No live UI, network-monitor, packet-capture, keychain, or filesystem acceptance checks were run because there is no corresponding product change.
title: Record the account service decision
